goal: Measured, transferable findings about the data pipeline of every training stage, carried into much larger later releases. The released models are the best branches of the experiments, not a separate production track.

model_family.architecture: KDA/NoPE-GQA hybrid, three KDA layers per global GQA layer, dense SwiGLU, tied embeddings
model_family.parameter_basis: Total parameters, embeddings included, as counted by speck.model.build_model. Configurations also record non-embedding parameters.
model_family.shape_rule: experiments/ladder/shapes.py: width w and G groups of three KDA layers and one GQA layer; head dimension 128, KDA w/256 key and w/128 value heads, GQA max(1, w/512) key-value heads, SwiGLU 2.5w. It reproduces the 1.2B reference exactly.

ladder.local_runs: The 50m rung also runs on the workstation RTX 3090 before grant access: seed-noise calibration and metric selection. Local runs spend no grant GPU-hours.

parent.schedule: warmup-stable-decay; decay experiments branch from preserved stable checkpoints
parent.mixture_rule: The starting mixture is a hypothesis. Ladder results set the parent mixture, repetition and horizon before launch; the final horizon is the smallest of supply, measured cost within the parent budget and the ladder's repetition evidence.

post_training.external_control_base: An open base of similar size (candidate: OLMo 2 1B, open data and intermediate checkpoints) receives the same post-training experiments as a control. It is never released as a Speck model.

projection.boundary: Projections for sizing only. The GH200 qualification replaces the utilization with measured rates per rung, after the overhead derate; run counts then follow from the budget lines, never the reverse.

measured_anchor.boundary: The frozen H100 pilot recipe: eager, activation checkpointing on, microbatch one, about 10% utilization. It bounds the parent cost from above and is replaced by the GH200 measurement.

rules: A budget line is a ceiling. Unused hours return to the reserve; lines never borrow from each other without a recorded revision.
A measured rate above the projection buys more experiment runs, not a longer parent run.
A measured rate below the projection shortens the parent horizon and trims 410m runs first; seed-noise runs and the evaluation line are never cut.
Count every allocated GPU, including idle devices, and charge each operation to exactly one line.
